d:
The Lakers defeated the Jazz, 109-94 tonight in Los Angeles. Luka Dončić finished with a team-high 28 points along with 8 assists and 4 rebounds for the Lakers, while Jake LaRavia tallied 15 points, 10 rebounds and 2 steals in the game. Kyle Filipowski recorded 21 points, 12 rebounds and 4 assists. The Lakers improve their record to 15-3 with the win, while the Jazz fall to 3-16 for the season.
